name: text-type-backspace-loop
title: Type & Backspace Loop
description: Gõ một từ, chờ, xoá lùi nhanh gấp đôi rồi gõ từ tiếp theo, con trỏ chỉ nhấp nháy khi nghỉ.

moworks.author: moworks

options.hold: s held before deleting (1.0, at least 0.7)
options.maxWord: s a word may take to type (0.9)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here
credit.upstream: after typed.js (GPL-3.0): written from the idea only

moworks.notes: Type word 1 at 60 ms / char (demo capped 0.9 s per word), hold (backDelay ≥ 0.7 s; GSAP recipe 1.5 s; demo fills the loop, up to 1.6 s), backspace at 30 ms / char (half the type interval), 0.25–0.3 s pause, type word 2, … (loop or stop on the last). Caret: accent bar ~2.5 px × 1 em, solid while typing / deleting; while idle it blinks as a smooth sine yoyo, 0.5 s per half (ease-in-out; demo floor 0.15 opacity). Demo loop 4.8 s. Params: words: danh sách từ · typeSpeed (0.06 s) · backSpeed (0.03 s) · backDelay: giữ trước khi xoá (≥0.7 s) · loop.
moworks.titleVi: Gõ chữ, xoá lùi, gõ từ tiếp
